card.fact_statement: 2024 YR4 has a rotation period near 19.5 minutes.
card.source_span: Photometric observations by the Very Large Telescope (VLT) and the La Silla Observatory's 1.54-metre (5.1 ft) telescope indicate 2024 YR4 has a rotation period near 19.5 minutes.
